objective: Measure one pooled cross-entity positioning signal and a matched House reading-layer ablation before scarce official submissions.
numeric_mechanism: Common small-sample ridge on three cross-sectionally centered positioning proxies in percentage-point units: horizon net momentum divided by current originOI; six-week mean of each weekly net change divided by its own preceding weeklyOI, times horizon; .35 times difference between thirteen-week mean net/OI shares and current net/OI share. The last two are proxies rather than exact horizon-origin-OI changes. Training targets divide future net change by initial originOI. Training pairs use only fully resolved nonoverlapping horizons inside visible input. Share generic coefficients across markets; fixed25% learned point plus75% exact parent point. No official outcome memory.

constants.interval_policy: Preserve parent bounds expanded only to contain final point; evaluate point shift and interval loss separately. No fitted coverage claim.

external_benchmark.source: CFTC legacy futures-only historical compressed annual reports
external_benchmark.origins: Every fifth shared Tuesday report from fixed first eligible report at or after period start; target exactly five subsequent weekly reports, continuous 7-day cadence. Availability is a conservative Tuesday+3days Friday assumption without exceptional holiday/release-delay metadata; reject non-Tuesday records and disclose this retrospective limitation. No imputed missing report or bridged gap.
external_benchmark.asset_selection: Resolve exact stable CFTC market codes using source metadata before outcome scoring; record absent or changed contracts. No selecting contracts by successful scores.
external_benchmark.input_contract: Report date, immutable market identifier, noncommercial long, noncommercial short, total open interest. Net is long minus short. Futures-only, all contract months.
external_benchmark.training_visibility: At each origin, evaluator passes only older released rows to candidate. Candidate cannot open benchmark labels or fetch external resources.
external_benchmark.label_contract: Evaluator-only future net change divided by initial origin open interest times100; point target is percent of origin open interest. Separate inputs and labels outside organizer tree.
external_benchmark.exposure: Historical contracts outside published2024 interval and originally unseen during candidate design; same market families so asset-generalization is not claimed. Development data consumed after run; reserved external outcomes read only after code and protocol freeze. A retrospective dataset is not the hidden contest distribution. Broad model historical knowledge remains a House evaluation limit.

metrics.primary: Equal-origin cross-sectional Spearman rho and Kendall tau, plus public anchored ranking scorer when valid naive bundle is available. No reconstructed official rank.
metrics.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap by full calendar year, preserve complete cross-sections; report finite small-cluster limits and all years. No iid entity/bootstrap claims.
metrics.admission: Predeclare material rho improvement0.03 with paired year-cluster lower95%bound above0, no full-year rho regression exceeding0.05, no MAE or interval-score regression above5%; otherwise preserve parent. At least four reserved years and45 scored cross-section origins required.

house_ablation.third_case_memory_arm: Not admitted until independently labeled successful procedural cases exist; current generic fictional cards are held fixed.
house_ablation.matched: Same frozen task/corpus, House model alias+pin, seed, temperature0, same parent controller/batch4/reviewer/requestcap25 and bounded context. Exact v4 issuer guard used in both arms. Only typed feature context differs.
house_ablation.labels: Need independent point-in-time EPS/credit cases; public eleven units carry no resolved targets. Public-unit model run can measure extraction/revision/latency but cannot establish forecast quality.
house_ablation.classification_accuracy_requirement: Avoid resolving published practice targets from historical memory; use separately declared noncompetition cases with evaluator-only labels.

resources: Existing local Python/numpy/pandas/scipy; candidate signal standard library only. No personal remote compute, model installation, inference internet, image publication or official submission.
immutability: Preserve organizer units/corpora/manifests and all v4 source files. New research only in this folder. Freeze protocol and candidate hashes before reserved accuracy.
